summary: First iteration end-to-end testing of Mindful Yoga app. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests passing (root, classes=4, payment create-order demo fallback starting with 'order_demo_', contact valid/invalid EmailStr 422, bookings list & persistence). Frontend: Home hero text renders, Navbar routes (Home/About/Classes/Blog/Contact) all resolve distinct content, Classes page lists 4 classes with visible ₹ prices and 4 Book Now buttons, BookingModal opens with name/email/phone fields and submit triggers demo-mode success, Blog shows featured + additional cards (detail modal opens), Contact form submits successfully, Footer present. Placeholder Razorpay/Resend keys handled gracefully as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: resend.api_key is set at module import before placeholder check; placeholder guard in /api/contact correctly prevents sending — fine.

CORS allow_origins from env splits on ','; with default '*' and allow_credentials=True, browsers may reject credentialed requests. Not hit in current flows (no cookies) but worth hardening before production.
Booking record stored even when Razorpay order creation fails (demo fallback). Acceptable for demo mode but should be gated in production to avoid polluting bookings collection.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed bookings and contacts rows in Mongo (not cleaned up; low volume, acceptable for demo).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. Placeholder Razorpay/Resend keys are intentional; demo order_id prefix is 'order_demo_' and email_sent=false is expected.
